The '''Wxtm system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wxtm]].
